title: National Abolition Hall of Fame and Museum

services.name: Featured Exhibits
services.desc: Traditional history often filters the antislavery movement through a lens focused entirely on male politicians and public lecturers. NAHOF directly counters this narrative through this exhibit which highlights the Women's Abolition Network. These interpretive displays explore how women were not merely auxiliary
